declarations.name: LulaTree.same_root_agreement_or_witness
declarations.statement:
{Addr : Type} {n : Nat}
    (H : List UInt8 → Node n) (header : Addr → List UInt8)
    (path₁ path₂ : List (Step Addr n)) (leaf₁ leaf₂ : Node n)
    (hs : schedule path₁ = schedule path₂)
    (hr : root H header leaf₁ path₁ = root H header leaf₂ path₂) :
    (leaf₁ = leaf₂ ∧ path₁ = path₂) ∨
      ∃ address x y,
        (address, x) ∈ trace H header leaf₁ path₁ ∧
        (address, y) ∈ trace H header leaf₂ path₂ ∧
        x ≠ y ∧ H x = H y

declarations.name: LulaTree.changed_leaf_or_path_yields_witness
declarations.statement:
{Addr : Type} {n : Nat}
    (H : List UInt8 → Node n) (header : Addr → List UInt8)
    (path₁ path₂ : List (Step Addr n)) (leaf₁ leaf₂ : Node n)
    (hs : schedule path₁ = schedule path₂)
    (hr : root H header leaf₁ path₁ = root H header leaf₂ path₂)
    (hd : leaf₁ ≠ leaf₂ ∨ path₁ ≠ path₂) :
    ∃ address x y,
      (address, x) ∈ trace H header leaf₁ path₁ ∧
      (address, y) ∈ trace H header leaf₂ path₂ ∧
      x ≠ y ∧ H x = H y

declarations.name: LulaWots.raw_value_injective
LulaWots.chain_start_equal_or_witness
declarations.statement:
{Addr : Type} {n : Nat}
    (H : List UInt8 → Node n) (header : Addr → List UInt8)
    (addresses : List Addr) (a b : Node n)
    (h : run H header addresses a = run H header addresses b) :
    a = b ∨ ∃ address x y,
      (address,x) ∈ trace H header addresses a ∧
      (address,y) ∈ trace H header addresses b ∧ x ≠ y ∧ H x = H y

declarations.name: LulaWots.changed_chain_start_witness
declarations.statement:
{Addr : Type} {n : Nat}
    (H : List UInt8 → Node n) (header : Addr → List UInt8)
    (addresses : List Addr) (a b : Node n)
    (h : run H header addresses a = run H header addresses b) (hn : a ≠ b) :
    ∃ address x y,
      (address,x) ∈ trace H header addresses a ∧
      (address,y) ∈ trace H header addresses b ∧ x ≠ y ∧ H x = H y

declarations.name: LulaWots.run_append
declarations.statement:
{Addr : Type} {n : Nat}
    (H : List UInt8 → Node n) (header : Addr → List UInt8)
    (before after : List Addr) (start : Node n) :
    run H header (before ++ after) start = run H header after (run H header before start)

declarations.name: LulaWots.last_step_preimage
declarations.statement:
{Addr : Type} {n : Nat}
    (H : List UInt8 → Node n) (header : Addr → List UInt8)
    (before : List Addr) (last : Addr) (start target : Node n)
    (h : run H header (before ++ [last]) start = target) :
    ∃ x, x = raw header last (run H header before start) ∧ H x = target

files.scope: Finite selector algebra and coordinate arithmetic, conditional on supplied root-error inequalities.

declarations.name: LulaQuantumSelector.sum_root_error_square
declarations.statement:
(s : Finset ι) (a b e : ι → R)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i)
    (he : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≤ b i + e i) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (a i)^2) ≤
      (∑ i ∈ s, (b i)^2) + 2*(∑ i ∈ s, b i*e i) + (∑ i ∈ s, (e i)^2)

declarations.name: LulaQuantumSelector.mixed_sum_bound
declarations.statement:
(s : Finset ι) (b e : ι → R) (c : R)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hcsq : c^2 = (∑ i ∈ s, (b i)^2)*(∑ i ∈ s, (e i)^2)) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, b i*e i) ≤ c

declarations.name: LulaQuantumSelector.padded_root_upper
declarations.statement:
(s : Finset ι) (a b e : ι → R)
    (L bbar deltaCut cross : R)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ a i) (hb : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ b i)
    (he : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ e i) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, a i ≤ b i + e i)
    (hB : (∑ i ∈ s, (b i)^2) = L*bbar)
    (hD : (∑ i ∈ s, (e i)^2) = deltaCut)
    (hc : 0 ≤ cross) (hcSq : cross^2 = L*bbar*deltaCut) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, (a i)^2) ≤ L*bbar + 2*cross + deltaCut
